g.text: Electrical headroom of the final normal-force controller
Native comparison: 2 kg tool, 50 N, 90° gravity orientation, μ = 0.3; current response 100 µs.
Force panels: 0–4 s, including startup, 1 mm / 10 mm bump at 100 mm/s, seeds 7 and 1729, 10 µs integration.
Real coil: 24.4 N/A, 6.4 Ω cold, 8.896 Ω hot (+100°C copper-rise assumption), 4 mH. The 19/20 and 31/32 V caps
represent explicit amplifier-headroom envelopes. Heat panel is arithmetic at 2.049 A, zero back EMF; coil heat 26.9 / 37.4 W.
Constant force coefficient and hypothetical hot copper do not qualify a motor’s travel-dependent force or safe temperature.
